sloka: गते तु तस्मिन् सुरराजशत्रुः क्रोधात् प्रदुद्राव रणाय भूयः।अनायुधो ऽस्मीति विचिन्त्य रौद्रो घोरं तदा मुद्गरमाससाद ।। ६.६७.९३ ।।
transliteration: gate tu tasmin surarājaśatruḥ krodhāt pradudrāva raṇāya bhūyaḥ।anāyudho 'smīti vicintya raudro ghoraṁ tadā mudgaramāsasāda ।। 6.67.93 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna of terrific valour and gigantic body, drenched in blood, dark in colour like a mountain of collyrium, resembling evening cloud, the night ranger went towards the battlefield.
